tasks.short: Design valid research and analysis plans

steps.what: Design research projects using historical evidence, valid methods and explicit analytical assumptions

tasks.design: Keep research design with the statistician, supported by existing calculations in {DATA_PLATFORM} and a documented plan in {DOCS}. Existing computation is already part of the baseline and does not establish a new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Choosing an estimand and defensible design requires scientific judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing statistical tools already support calculations and exploration.
tasks.still_hard: Bias, confounding, measurement validity and practical feasibility.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a technically computable analysis does not answer the research question.
tasks.altitude: No change to design authority or working time is established.

reach.learn: Domain-specific outcomes and sources of bias

evidence.claim: Research design involves scientific method choice and assumptions; existing statistical runtime alone is not removable human effort.

assumptions: Boundary includes design and analysis planning, excluding production data processing and later interpretation of study findings.
Statistician establishes question, population, outcomes, estimand, assumptions and source suitability within s1; no automatically valid analysis specification is assumed.
Test native statistical capabilities before custom code; no new automation is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because existing tools and design practice remain unchanged.
unknowns: Whether recurring designs contain repeated clerical calculations
research_questions: Can actual design time logs isolate repeated setup from substantive scientific decisions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Existing computation and scientific design remain counted; no clerical share is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Adapt statistical methods to specific problems

steps.what: Adapt statistical methods, test assumptions and establish their suitability for the specific problem

tasks.design: Retain method adaptation and validation with the statistician in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Reusable statistical libraries can support the work, but running an existing method is not a new saving in deciding whether that method is appropriate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The adaptation depends on domain meaning and statistical assumptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing libraries and reproducible experiments support expert work.
tasks.still_hard: Nonstandard data, model misspecification and interpreting failures.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a standard method must be changed or rejected.
tasks.altitude: Methodological authority and working time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Relevant mathematical foundations and domain constraints

evidence.claim: Method adaptation and suitability assessment require expert judgement; no task-specific labour reduction is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive method adaptation and validation, excluding repeated production processing in the separate processing task.
Statistician derives problem constraints, assumptions, diagnostics and acceptance criteria within s1; no free structured method selection or suitability flag is assumed.
Native libraries and configuration are considered before custom implementation; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the existing method-development process remains unchanged.
unknowns: Proportion of work that repeats previously validated methods
research_questions: Which adaptations repeat enough to justify a separately maintained validated implementation?

already_counted.description: Method development, diagnostics and suitability decisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Existing library computation is not newly removed human labour; substantive adaptation remains counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect information sources and capture provenance, definitions and evaluation criteria
Calculate source completeness, duplicate counts and specified consistency checks
Evaluate source limitations, investigate failures and determine permitted uses

tasks.design: Configure repeatable profiles and explicit checks in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The statistician still establishes the criteria and judges whether the source can support the intended inference, recording limitations in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly assembling basic profiles distracts from evaluating source limitations.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured checks can rerun fixed definitions on a versioned source snapshot.
tasks.still_hard: A complete, internally consistent dataset can still be biased or unsuitable.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting provenance and measurement limitations to the intended use.
tasks.altitude: A modest gain shifts attention from repeated profile setup to investigating source limitations.

evidence.claim: Explicit completeness and consistency rules can be computed deterministically, but source suitability still requires judgement.

assumptions: Boundary covers source evaluation, not research design or production transformations; shared profile work must be allocated once if reused.

Statistician creates source version, field definitions, keys, missing-value rules, bounds and intended-use criteria in s1, with capture time included. Source owners provide existing documentation; missing definitions require retained investigation rather than inferred flags.
Test native profiling and validation configuration first. Unreadable files or unspecified rules go to manual checks in s3.
Savings apply only to human profile setup repeated today; existing automatic checks and computer runtime earn no new saving.
unknowns: Availability of stable schemas and usable provenance
research_questions: How much repeated setup remains after accounting for existing automated checks and source-specific investigations?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75, gross25 minus focal upkeep8 gives net17. Range allows unstable sources and existing automated profiles to consume most or all proposed gain; interpretation remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Process data for modelling and graphics

steps.what: Inspect input data and specify processing mappings, filters and transformation rules
Prepare repeated processing batches and run the specified data transformations
Reconcile processing results, resolve exceptions and release the analysis dataset

tasks.design: Configure reproducible batch execution in {DATA_PLATFORM} from a statistician-owned processing specification. Retain input interpretation, transformation design, exception resolution and dataset release with the statistician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated batch preparation can involve manually selecting files and reapplying established mappings.
tasks.enabler_now: A versioned pipeline can reuse validated mappings and produce run manifests.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting silent meaning changes and deciding how missing or inconsistent data should be treated.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a technically successful transformation is analytically wrong.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated batch preparation can support deeper reconciliation of unusual data.

reach.learn: Pipeline versioning and schema change controls

evidence.claim: pharmaverse includes admiral for deriving analysis datasets and rtables for tables, supporting reusable deterministic statistical pipelines.
The proposed batch preparation saving is an unmeasured assumption; computer execution time is excluded.

assumptions: Boundary is data preparation for modelling and graphics; method choice, source suitability and final statistical interpretation are separate and not credited here.

Statistician produces snapshot IDs, column types, keys, joins, filters, missing-value treatment and transformation versions in s1, including capture time. Existing source collection is unchanged; no new work is transferred to data owners.
Test native scheduled pipelines first. Schema drift, unresolved joins or failed reconciliations stop the batch for manual resolution in s3.
The 25-hour component represents human repeat setup and file handling only; existing automatic execution and machine runtime earn no additional saving.
unknowns: Current proportion of repeated manual batch preparation
Existing validated pipelines and source stability
research_questions: Do batch logs show repeatable human setup that remains after existing automation and reconciliation are counted?

incremental.description: Pipeline regression checks and transformation upkeep
Platform operation and source interface maintenance

approvals.approved_version: Input snapshot, mapping and code versions, run manifest and released dataset checksum; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75, gross25 minus focal upkeep10 gives net15. Range allows existing pipelines and source changes to remove most of the opportunity; interpretation and release keep their full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains scientific decisions while reducing measured repetitive setup where it still exists.
reach: Specify quality and pipeline contracts with data warehousing specialists
role.ambitious_version: Use verified setup savings to investigate data limitations and strengthen reproducibility.
